latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — easily create and export finished movies with AI-powered cloud rendering.

- Upload video clips (up to 500MB; MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM supported).
- Describe your desired edit (e.g., “combine my clips, add transitions, and export...”).
- Automatic session/token handling for quick onboarding (100 free credits/7 days).
- Download polished 1080p MP4 movies in about 1–2 minutes.
- Built-in commands for export, credits, status, and uploads.
- Designed for fast, friendly video creation for casual users and students — no editing experience required.
